SynchronizeLiveSourceLayer(LiveSourceElement)

Projects the Mainframe live-input adjustment controls into one canonical layer while preserving any additional user-authored layers. Streaming preview and program output therefore use the same layer/filter renderer as Video Studio instead of a separate chroma/filter implementation.
